verdict.rationale: Pigment's finance use-case page says the platform integrates data 'through native connectors, open APIs, and scheduled imports', and it offers an HR/workforce planning use case. That points to its own data-ingestion capability feeding planning models, but no payroll/HRIS or CRM connector is named. The Agent Connectors (Notion, Drive, Slack) are for agent context, not model data import, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: named payroll/HRIS connectors (e.g., Workday), named CRM connectors (e.g., Salesforce), evidence that headcount and pipeline data land in the same model as GL/actuals, independent or hands-on corroboration.
